_notice: Default values for Multi-D sharing factors. Entries flagged provisional:true are estimates; refine with Eurostat, World Bank, FAOSTAT and Danish EPA (Miljøstyrelsen) before publication. Entries flagged provisional:false name a dataset and a data year in their own source field. Every layer-1 principle is a SINGLE-YEAR snapshot keyed at year_base: a value at a point in time over the world value at the same point. AR was moved onto Climate TRACE 2022 and is no longer an estimate; it previously held a cumulative 1850-2020 CO2 total, which is a different quantity from the other four and is the basis error the provenance guard now prevents.

AR.description: Acquired rights: share of current annual emissions
AR.unit: t CO2e-100yr per year, all sectors, data year 2022
AR.source: Climate TRACE Country Inventory, data year 2022. Denmark total across all sectors 59.3 Mt CO2e-100yr; world total 60.57 Gt CO2e-100yr. Metric is CO2e on a 100-year GWP basis, not CO2 alone. SINGLE-YEAR, like the other four principles: this is a snapshot of the emissions share at a point in time, not a cumulative total over a historical window. Keyed at year_base 2025 (the assessment base year) even though the data year is 2022, which is the convention every principle in this file follows.

layer2.source: Passenger cars ~60% of Danish transport GHG × transport ~25% of national total ≈ 0.15. Provisional — refine with Danish EPA sectoral breakdown.
